purpose: Validate image embedding normalization, vector-ID mapping, FAISS index consistency, and exact retrieval.

similarity.method: cosine similarity implemented by inner product
similarity.formula: cos(a,b) = (a dot b) / (||a|| * ||b||) = a dot b for unit vectors
similarity.meaning: Ranks vectors by their direction similarity; larger scores indicate greater similarity.

dataset_scope.source: 100 vectors sampled from the existing 10,000-image training knowledge base
dataset_scope.reason: The 100 queries are vectors already present in the index, so this measures index consistency rather than unseen-data generalization.

what_it_proves: FAISS and the embedding matrix contain the same number of vectors.
FAISS row positions correspond to image-ID mapping rows.
Known vectors can be retrieved and the exact matching vector ranks first.
what_it_does_not_prove: Comparison quality against another student's held-out benchmark.
interpretation.main_limitation: Self-retrieval uses stored vectors as both queries and candidates; it does not represent unseen RAG retrieval quality.
